create_pqmf_module: create a PQMF module with 4 subbands for audio subband decomposition
build_prototype_filter: build a prototype filter using Kaiser window with configurable taps and cutoff ratio
run_pqmf_analysis: run PQMF analysis to split an audio tensor into subband components
run_pqmf_synthesis: run PQMF synthesis to reconstruct audio from subband components
test_pqmf_reconstruction: test PQMF analysis and synthesis for near-perfect audio reconstruction
